fact: Niger's replies to the CRPD list of issues, received 7 February 2019, say article 37 of the equal opportunities bill obliges public and private entities to make information and communication technologies accessible to persons with disabilities, and that facilities for accessible new ICT are planned.
title: Replies of the Niger to the list of issues in relation to the initial report of the Niger
publisher: United Nations Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
